message.body: $QNT Quantinuum is still the technical leader in trapped-ion quantum computing. In the second quarter it reported $8 million of revenue, up 279% from a year earlier, and guided full-year 2026 revenue to $28–32 million, above what analysts had expected. Bookings were running ahead of that. It has an Oracle Cloud deal to put the Helios system in an Oracle data center, a finalized $100 million CHIPS R&D award, about $2.1 billion in cash after the June IPO, and a claimed near 99.999% logical-qubit fidelity on Helios.  The lab and the balance sheet are in good shape.  The income statement and share price will follow.😎
